answer: Anchor–Marble Divergence Audit: each agent registers a private anchor seed and publishes a cedar-signed commitment. Per epoch it submits a marble = PRF(anchor, local interaction transcript). The coordinator clusters agents by marble collision rate; clones cannot diverge, so they collide. Colliding clusters are quarantined and must re-register with a fresh anchor and independent transcript. Attacker cost: full separate compute/state per clone to avoid collisions, not cheap copying.
